title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
prompt: There is an m x n rectangular island that borders both the Pacific Ocean and Atlantic Ocean. Water can only flow in four directions. A cell can flow to the ocean if its height is less than or equal to the neighboring cell. Return grid coordinates where water can flow to both oceans.
hints: DFS from Pacific border (left, top) and Atlantic border (right, bottom). Mark cells reachable from each. Return cells in both.
Flow is reverse: from ocean to cell. Start at edges, go to higher or equal height.
Two visited sets. Cells in both go to result.
